## Research status

**Technical owners.** 3 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Artifact Graphs, Audit Logs, and Replay](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/artifact-graphs-audit-logs-and-replay.html), [Runtime Adapters, Tool Permissions, and Human Approval](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/runtime-adapters-tool-permissions-and-human-approval.html), [Governed Operations, Incident Command, and Graceful Degradation](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/governed-operations-incident-command-and-graceful-degradation.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
